guideTitle: Best Sunburst Mirrors for the Living Room (2026)
metaTitle: Best Sunburst Mirrors for the Living Room
metaDescription: Six sunburst mirrors compared on overall size versus glass size, frame material, weight, hanging hardware and finish, with placement advice for a living room.
expertTake: The SAFAVIEH 36 inch iron mirror is our top pick because it states its size, depth and 13 pound weight plainly and uses keyhole hanging hardware. The Cityelf set of three is the value pick for a light, flexible cluster on a wall. Skip a sunburst mirror if you need a mirror to check your outfit, because most of the frame is rays and the glass in the middle is small.
introParagraphs: A sunburst mirror is a wall piece with a central glass and rays that fan out from it, in metal, wood or mirrored strips. It is more sculpture than looking glass, and it brings a warm, glamorous or boho focal point to a plain wall.

The detail that most buyers overlook is how small the glass is compared with the whole piece. This guide compares the overall size, the glass diameter, the frame material, the weight and the hanging hardware, and gives placement advice so the mirror lights a room instead of reflecting clutter. It also includes an option offered in several sizes, so you can match the mirror to the wall.

products.name: SAFAVIEH Glam Sunburst Mirror 36 In, Gold, Keyhole Hanging
products.description:
SAFAVIEH lists clear dimensions: a 36 by 36 inch frame, 0.5 inches deep, with an 11 by 11 inch mirror inside, weighing 13 pounds. The frame is iron, glass and engineered wood in a gold glam finish, with keyhole hardware on the back for hanging. It is a large piece that bounces daylight around an entryway, living room or hallway.

The 11 inch glass inside a 36 inch frame shows the real ratio: about 8 percent of the area is mirror. That is fine for a decor piece, but not for checking your hair. Compared with the MOCOME, the SAFAVIEH is larger and heavier with clearer specs. Keyhole hanging works only if you hit a stud or use rated anchors.

Mark the keyhole positions with a level and use anchors rated well above 13 pounds. Dust the rays with a soft brush. It suits a living room wall above a console or a sofa.
products.bestFor: Large walls that need a glam focal point with clear specs.
pros: Lists exact size, depth and 13 pound weight
36 inch frame has real presence on a wall
Keyhole hardware makes hanging simple
Iron, glass and engineered wood build feels solid
cons: Glass is only 11 inches, so it is decor, not a dressing mirror
13 pounds needs studs or rated anchors

products.name: MOCOME Large Gold Sunburst Mirror 31 In, 12 In Round Glass
products.description:
MOCOME makes a 31 inch gold starburst mirror with a 12 inch round glass in the center and rays of metal wire. The wire rays are thin and light, which gives the piece an airy look and keeps the weight down. The mid century style suits many rooms.

Wire rays can bend if bumped or hung carelessly, and thin metal gold finishes can scratch. The 12 inch glass is a bit larger than the SAFAVIEH's glass by diameter, though still modest. Compared with the DUOHONG, the MOCOME is metal and open while the DUOHONG has solid mirrored strips. It sits in the lower middle of the price order.

Hang on a stud or a rated anchor and straighten the rays after hanging. Dust with a soft brush. It suits a living room wall where a light, airy sunburst is wanted.
products.bestFor: Walls that want a light, airy gold starburst.
pros: 31 inch diameter fills a wall without feeling heavy
12 inch round glass is a usable size for a decor mirror
Metal wire rays are light and easy to hang
Mid century style suits many rooms
cons: Thin wire rays can bend if bumped
Gold finish on thin metal can scratch

products.name: DUOHONG 25.6 In Gold Sunburst Mirror, Beveled Glass Rays
products.description:
DUOHONG uses multi faceted mirrored strips for the rays, so the whole piece reflects light, not only the center. The listing says the surface is shatterproof and family safe, which is a claim we could not verify. The piece is 25.6 inches wide and the beveled strips scatter light in all directions.

Mirrored rays create more sparkle than metal ones and also show fingerprints and dust. Shatterproof surfaces are useful near children, but any mirror should be hung securely. Compared with the MOCOME, the DUOHONG is smaller and more reflective, and it suits a dark wall where extra light helps. It sits in the upper part of the price order.

Wipe with a microfiber cloth and avoid harsh cleaners. Hang on a rated anchor. It suits a dim hallway or living room where sparkle and light are wanted.
products.bestFor: Dim rooms and halls that need extra sparkle and light.
pros: Mirrored rays scatter light in many directions
Shatterproof surface is claimed for family safety
25.6 inch size suits a mid size wall
Beveled strips add a glamorous sparkle
cons: Mirrored rays show fingerprints and dust easily
Shatterproof claim could not be verified

products.name: Cityelf Set of 3 Gold Sunburst Mirrors, 11.8 In Round Glass
products.description:
Cityelf sells three metal sunburst mirrors in a boho style, each with an 11.8 inch round glass, lightweight and with hanging hardware included. A set of three lets you build a cluster, a diagonal line or a row. The set sits in the lower part of the price order.

Three small mirrors create a gallery effect that a single piece cannot, and the light weight makes hanging easy. The tradeoff is scale: each piece is small, and a cluster needs planning to look intentional. Compared with the MOCOME, the Cityelf set is cheaper and more flexible. Overall frame sizes are not stated in our snippet, so check them.

Lay out the three on the floor and mark with painter's tape. Dust with a soft brush. It suits a gallery wall or a bare wall that needs a boho accent.
products.bestFor: Gallery walls and clusters in a boho room.
pros: Three mirrors let you build a cluster or a row
11.8 inch round glass is a decent size for each piece
Lightweight, so hanging is easy
Lower part of the price order for three mirrors
cons: Overall frame sizes need checking before ordering
A cluster needs planning to avoid looking random

products.name: Honiway Rustic Wood Sunburst Mirror 12 In, Handmade Boho
products.description:
Honiway makes a 12 inch handmade sunburst mirror from solid wood with a torched finish and high polish silver glass, in a shabby chic boho style. The listing says the glass prevents distortion. The wood rays give a warm, natural look that suits farmhouse and boho rooms.

At 12 inches overall, it is a small accent, not a statement piece, and it suits an entryway, a bedroom or a gallery wall. Handmade pieces vary slightly, and a torched finish can leave soot on your fingers at first. Compared with the Cityelf, the Honiway is warmer and a single piece. It is second lowest in the price order of this lineup.

Wipe gently with a dry cloth. Hang with the included hardware. It suits a small wall where a natural, rustic accent is welcome.
products.bestFor: Small walls and entryways that want a rustic wood accent.
pros: Solid wood with a torched finish gives a natural look
High polish silver glass is said to avoid distortion
Handmade character suits boho and farmhouse rooms
Small size suits entryways and gallery walls
cons: 12 inch size is an accent, not a focal point
Handmade pieces vary and the torched finish can mark fingers

products.name: Creative Co-Op Gold Sunburst Mirror, Gilded Wood Frame
products.description:
Creative Co-Op makes a gold sunburst mirror with a gilded wood frame and an intricate ray design, with hanging mechanisms included. The listing calls it glamorous and suited to a living room, bedroom or hallway. Wood rays give it more warmth than iron.

Our snippet lists no dimensions or weight, so check the full page before buying, since the size decides everything. A gilded finish is delicate and chips at the points of the rays. Compared with the SAFAVIEH, the Creative Co-Op is wood and less well documented. It is the highest in the price order of this lineup.

When it arrives, inspect the rays for breaks and hang on a rated anchor. Dust with a soft brush. It suits a traditional or glam living room with a budget for a statement piece.
products.bestFor: Traditional or glam rooms that want a gilded wood piece.
pros: Gilded wood frame with intricate rays looks luxurious
Hanging mechanisms are included
Wood is warmer than iron in tone
Suits living rooms, bedrooms and halls
cons: Listing snippet gives no dimensions or weight
Highest in the price order and the gilding can chip

products.name: HLFMVWE Gold Iron Sunburst Mirror, 12 to 24 In Sizes
products.description:
HLFMVWE sells an iron framed sunburst mirror in four sizes, 12, 16, 20 and 24 inches, with a clear glass mirror and an additional locking hole bracket for mounting. The size range is the useful part, since you can pick the diameter that suits the wall instead of settling for one. It is the lowest in the price order of this lineup.

An iron frame is sturdier than thin wire, and the locking bracket helps a mirror hang flat. The listing does not show the glass diameter for each size, so check the full page before ordering. Compared with the Cityelf, the HLFMVWE is a single piece in a size you choose. Gold finishes on iron can still scratch at the tips.

Pick the size by measuring the wall and holding a paper circle against it. Dust with a soft brush. It suits a living room wall where the right size matters more than a fixed design.
products.bestFor: Walls that need a specific size and a low cost iron frame.
pros: Four sizes from 12 to 24 inches suit different walls
Iron frame is sturdier than thin wire rays
Extra locking bracket helps the mirror hang flat
Lowest in the price order of this lineup
cons: Glass size for each diameter is not shown in the listing we reviewed
Gold finish on iron can scratch at the ray tips

buyingCriteria.explanation: A sunburst mirror is mostly rays. The SAFAVIEH has an 11 inch glass in a 36 inch frame, the MOCOME a 12 inch glass in a 31 inch frame. If you want to see yourself, buy a separate mirror. Treat a sunburst as decor. Cut a paper circle at the overall diameter and tape it up for a day to judge the scale.

Metal wire is light and airy but bends. Iron is sturdier and heavier. Wood adds warmth, and mirrored strips add sparkle. Gold coatings can scratch on any base. Check how the rays are attached, since glued rays can drop off over time.

A 13 pound mirror, like the SAFAVIEH, needs a stud or anchors rated well above its weight. Light sets like the Cityelf hang on small nails. Keyhole, wire and cleat mounts differ in how forgiving they are.

Hang a mirror opposite or beside a window to reflect daylight. Keep it out of direct sun that fades finishes, and avoid reflecting clutter or a harsh light. A sunburst looks best on a plain, neutral wall. A mirror placed across from a lamp doubles its glare at night, so think about lighting.

Gold suits glam and mid century rooms, wood suits boho and farmhouse, and mirrored strips suit a dark wall. Match the metal to other fixtures in the room. A mix of finishes is fine in small doses. If your room has several metals, one gold accent often looks better than three.
Large sunbursts arrive in big flat cartons, and rays can bend in transit. Inspect on arrival. Plan two people to hang a large piece. Open the carton at once and photograph any damage for a return.

specDecoder.meaning: The total width of the sunburst including rays. It decides wall coverage.
specDecoder.watchFor: The SAFAVIEH lists 36 inches and the DUOHONG 25.6. Always check how the diameter is measured, to the tips or to the base.

specDecoder.meaning: The size of the reflecting surface in the center. It is much smaller than the overall size.
specDecoder.watchFor: The MOCOME lists a 12 inch glass in a 31 inch frame. Some listings leave the glass size out.

specDecoder.meaning: Glass with an angled edge that catches light. It is a decorative detail.
Slots on the back that hang over screws in the wall. They are simple but need accurate screw placement.
The weight of the mirror. It decides the anchor you need.

howWeEvaluated.description: We compared overall sizes with glass sizes. The SAFAVIEH and MOCOME show the ratio. These are editorial assessments based on the spec sheet, not measurements.

howWeEvaluated.title: Frame and build
howWeEvaluated.description: We read the frame materials. Iron and wood scored for durability, wire for lightness. We noted finishes that scratch.

howWeEvaluated.title: Hanging and weight
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at hardware and weight. The SAFAVIEH listed both. We marked down listings without dimensions.

howWeEvaluated.title: Style and placement
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared styles and where they suit. Gold and wood suit different rooms. We noted the best backgrounds.

howWeEvaluated.title: Ownership patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at owner feedback patterns about bent rays, scratched finishes and sizes smaller than expected. These shaped the cons for each pick.

cards.label: Metal
cards.text: The SAFAVIEH, MOCOME and Cityelf are crisp and glam. They can bend or scratch.

cards.label: Wood
cards.text: The Honiway and Creative Co-Op are warm and natural. They are delicate at the points.

howToChoose.note: Choose metal for glam and wood for boho or farmhouse.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A size that fills about two thirds of the space above the furniture, a plain background and a safe hanging method.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The SAFAVIEH and MOCOME are the living room statement picks. The Cityelf suits a gallery wall.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a large iron or gilded piece with clear specs, as with the SAFAVIEH or Creative Co-Op.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You want a cluster or a small accent, and the Cityelf or Honiway will do.

maintenance.why: Dust collects in the rays. A soft brush avoids bending thin metal.
Fingerprints show on glass. Use a microfiber cloth and avoid sprays near the frame.
Screws and anchors loosen under weight. Pull test gently.
Rays can bend and spoil the shape. Bend gently back.
Direct sun fades gold and wood finishes. Move the mirror if needed.

faq.q: Can I use a sunburst mirror as a dressing mirror?
faq.a: Not really. The glass is small compared with the frame. Use a separate mirror for checking your outfit. A sunburst works best as a wall accent.

faq.q: How big should it be above a sofa?
faq.a: About two thirds of the sofa width is the common rule. A 36 inch mirror suits a sofa of about 54 inches or a console.
Small sets are light, while a 36 inch iron piece such as the SAFAVIEH weighs 13 pounds. Anchor to match.
Opposite or beside a window and on a plain wall. Avoid reflecting clutter. Check the angle from the sofa before you drive the screw.
Yes, coatings can scratch. Dust with a soft brush and avoid rough cloths.

faq.q: Can I hang them in a bathroom?
faq.a: Wood and iron may suffer in damp air. Keep them out of a steamy room.
